{{Quote|The Gungans grow their paint balls in Otoh Gunga.|The slingshot announcer|<ref name="Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center">''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''</ref>}}
A type of natural '''paint ball''' was grown by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], an [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Those organic spheres filled with [[Color/Legends|pigments]] were farmed in the underwater [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]], and they were used by the performers of [[Gungan sling painting|sling painting]]&mdash;including the famous quartet known as the [[Gungan Sling Brigade]]. They were somewhat similar in shape to the [[Booma/Legends|boomas]] used by the [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] of the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan's natural paint balls first appeared in the [[2000]] educational video game ''[[Star Wars: Early Learning Activity Center]]''.
